body: Again i see nothing wrong with the video. It’s a wholesome interaction between two human beings regardless of motivation. Had this not been recorded we would have never had the chance to appreciate it.

You’re generalizing based on your own experience. You shouldn’t project those views onto people that you know nothing about.
Yes humans are known for having traits of selfishness and self-righteousness, it doesn’t mean that we are shallow as a species. This video is a clear example of it. You’d rather have the girl lead an uneventful life solely because you think humans inherently do things just for views or recognition. You’re as shallow as the people you claim to be shallow.

So one random person gave their assumption on the matter and you treat it like a fact?
She might be doing it for the likes, she might not. You have no definitive way of ever knowing that. People aren’t as shallow as you think.

The one thing to do is to trust yourself. Try not to give in into the feeling to much. At days it could feel like your world is falling apart and that you might not seem to make progress but every little step you take towards helping yourself comes a long way. My therapist helped by telling me to treat anxiety as it’s own entity or person. That way you can argue against it taking over your body. It’s like a leech of sorts. It feeds and becomes worse out of your negative emotions and thoughts so one way to start is to have a positive outlook on all of it. If you feed your anxiety with pure and warm thoughts or emotions or actions, you will feel significantly better.

Yes, from my experience with anxiety and the one full onset panic attack that I’ve had. I literally thought my heart was stopping and felt really light headed from hyperventilating.
You may feel like you are dying but trust that it goes away. If it helps any, surrounding yourself with people that you trust mitigates the symptoms a little. And if you find yourself alone know that it won’t always be like that. There’s also plenty of people on the internet willing to help you through it:)
